rationale: Detuned for +60s delay: KP 0.90->0.45, removed KD 28->0, increased filtering TF_F 8->18s TF_S 35->60s, U_MAX 0.68->0.60, slew 0.08*dt->0.025*dt, added 90s exponential setpoint ramp and retuned adaptive feedforward KA 0.005->0.008 with FF_GATE 0.10->0.08. Removes delay-sensitive derivative kick, prevents initial saturation blast, and learns hold power online so same law is stable on nominal and slow plant.

extra.machine_card: Heater slow-delay variant: Td~75s (+60s), tau~270s (1.6x), K~1.1 unchanged, amb~0.14 unchanged. Same hold u~0.30-0.34 but 0.10+ overshoot and 400s+ settle if driven aggressively.
extra.predicted_behavior: If delay hypothesis is right, initial u~0.50 not 0.67, peak <0.55 (<0.03 overshoot vs 0.11), no undershoot below 0.46, enter 0.475-0.525 by ~260s nominal / ~330s slow, in-band after 300s >=0.75-0.85 vs 0.53 now, MAE ~0.013-0.018 vs 0.032, energy similar or lower, zero overrides/violations on both nominal and slow machines.
extra.diagnosis: Closed-loop overshoot/oscillation with unchanged steady-state gain indicates added lag, not loss of gain or extra leak. Discovery: amb~0.14, K~(0.409-0.14)/0.25=1.08, tau~165s from E1 69% rise in 200s, Td~10-25s. Hidden v1: same K would predict y=0.14+1.08*0.298=0.462 but measured 0.494 (+0.032 high) and peak 0.57-0.58 with slow decay still out-of-band after 300s. Hidden v2: u~0.281 holds y~0.515, implied K=1.33 if amb fixed, but late slope ~0 and mean only +0.015 above target, so steady-state offset small. Large transient is the failure: v2 peaks 0.61-0.62 (+0.11), troughs 0.44-0.45, period ~450-500s peak-to-peak, classic delay hunt. Early slope ~0.002/s similar to discovery, so heating power similar. Needing LESS u (0.28 vs nominal 0.34) contradicts actuator_weaker (needs MORE u, same decay) and outflow_increased (needs MORE u, faster zero-input decay). No after_change zero-input decay was run to separate those directly, but steady-state argues against them. Estimated new Td~70-90s (+~60s vs ~15s) and tau~260-300s (~1.6x vs ~165s).
